risk: Stale inventory snapshot makes cover and stockout figures wrong for a market
mitigation: Freshness check INV_STALE runs every week and raises a P1 data action before KPIs are shared

risk: Past-due POs are excluded from projected receipts so stockout risk is overstated when a late PO actually lands
mitigation: LATE_PO exceptions list every excluded PO with open quantity so the planner can override by hand

risk: Forecast bias on a high-volume SKU goes unnoticed because WAPE looks acceptable at market level
mitigation: SKU-level bias exception above 20 percent with a minimum volume filter

risk: LLM drafted summary states a number that is not in the data
mitigation: Draft sees only computed facts; a number check flags unknown figures; a person approves before it is used

risk: Action owners are roles not names so accountability can blur
mitigation: Map roles to named people in the team tracker before real use

impact: SLA days) are generic and not tuned to category or market
status: All thresholds live in config.py and the decision log; review with planners before relying on them
